name: hlc-app
description: HLC Club — functional-eating PWA + Capacitor native shell (iOS/Android). The web app is served standalone from the repo root via GitHub Pages; Capacitor is an additive native wrapper that bundles the SAME web assets.

scripts.android:open: npm run build:www && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run build:www && cap sync ios && cap open ios
